parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of items to skip. Useful for pagination (page number * limit)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of items to fetch

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The user ID of the user making the request

parameters.name: entity_id
parameters.description: The ID of the entity to get events for

parameters.name: entity_type
parameters.description: The type of entity to get events for
